neighbours.label: A striving or intention word under negation (not trying, no desire to, not looking to, never sought), vs the same striving words stated affirmatively
fire: After the injury, the striker was not really trying to score; he just wanted to finish the match.
My grandmother had no desire to move closer to the city, even after the flood.
The startup is not looking to raise more money until next spring.
Honestly, I didn't try very hard on that exam because I had already passed the course.
The senator never sought a second term and returned to teaching law.
He had no ambition to run the family firm and became a carpenter instead.
She is not aiming to break the record this season, only to stay healthy.
They weren't really trying to sell the house; they listed it to see what offers came in.
quiet: After the injury, the striker was really trying to score, chasing every loose ball.
My grandmother had a deep desire to move closer to the city after the flood.
The startup is looking to raise more money before next spring.
Honestly, I tried very hard on that exam because I needed it to pass the course.
The senator eagerly sought a second term and campaigned across the state.
He had a great ambition to run the family firm and studied business for it.
She is aiming to break the record this season and trains twice a day.
They were really trying to sell the house and lowered the price twice.

predictions: Fire items 0.2-0.4 on the striving word; affirmative near misses under 0.15.
notes: Card: ' trying' after 'isn't really', 'didn't try', 'had no wish', 'not looking to', 'had not really had ambition to'; + pole is affirmative ' wants'. Probe: 'wasn't really trying' 0.317, 'had no wish' 0.274, 'not looking to expand' 0.343; affirmative 'was really trying' 0.059, 'a strong wish' 0.125, 'are looking to expand' 0.048, 'sought new investors' 0.084.
